name: twisted-shaft-solid-coarse
reference: Benchmark B14. Solid circular shaft under pure torsion (St Venant), a = 25 mm, L = 100 mm, E = 200 GPa, nu = 0.3 so G = E/(2(1+nu)) = 76.923076923... GPa. J = pi a^4 / 2 = 6.135923151542566e-7 m^4. Clamped (axial and circumferential DOFs held) at z = 0, load.torque total = 100 N*m at z = L. Closed form: u_theta(r,z) = T r z / (G J), tau_theta_z(r) = T r / J (independent of z). u_theta = alpha r z is exactly bilinear in the (r, z) meridional plane, and on this axis-aligned rectangular mesh r and z each vary with one parametric coordinate only, so quad4 reproduces it to machine precision on any mesh: this row and its -fine sibling are the same closed form on a 2x3 and a 6x10 mesh, both gated at 1e-9 on the tip twist and 1e-8 on the surface shear. u_theta(a, L) = 5.296676506098277e-6 m, tau_theta_z(a) = 4074366.54315252 Pa.

checks.note: u_theta(a, L) = T L a / (G J), the tip twist
tau_theta_z(a) = T a / J, Voigt row 5 under axisymmetric twist
